detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Space Manager is a complex sandbox simulation where you make strategic decisions on behalf of your growing aerospace empire. Accept contracts, launch satellites into orbit, scan planets for useful data, design your own space missions and much more!

Wishlist Space Manager today and join our incredible community on Discord (Manager Games) to follow updates and forward your feedback.

Space Manager is the game for you if you enjoy:

  • Managing your finances and building the economy by balancing missions and other tasks.

  • Space exploration and navigating into the unknown.

  • Observing space-flight simulations as you launch your rockets.

  • Expanding your base and growing a simulated aerospace empire.

  • Upgrading your skills and growth via a large research & development skill tree.

  • Engineering custom solutions for your launches, such as trajectory and ascent details.

  • Planning, experimenting and optimizing outcomes.

Choose a launch center on Earth

Begin your journey by choosing the ideal spaceport site, each offering unique strategic advantages. Geography, weather, and regional bonuses shape the efficiency and cost of your launches.

Take on contracts and complete missions

Launching rockets is expensive, so you need to secure some income. Take on contracts, send satellites into orbit of Earth, the moon and other planets to earn cash, reputation and XP.

Launch a variety of rockets into space

Enjoy the space-flight simulations as you launch vehicles into the cosmos. But don’t get too relaxed, every launch requires your attention - even when the precautions are taken and calculations appear correct, things can go south.

Scan planets and sell data

Gain valuable data about the cosmos and make discoveries. Install sensors and utilize your telescope to capture planet bodies and gather information about radio emission, atmosphere, magnetosphere, temperature and more. Build data centers to auction and sell data on the market.

Research and development

Hire a chief research developer and dive into the world of skills and upgrades to smoothen your space exploration journey. E.g. decrease the risk of launch failure with a launch safety supervisor, reduce procurement costs with a talented negotiator or unlock a data warehouse to increase data storage capacity.

Engineer your solutions

Customize and test your own engine profiles through a variety of detailed parameters such as thrust, efficiency, endurance and overdrive.

Design your own missions

Dive into the sandbox part of Space Manager and set up custom missions and design your own payloads. Put your knowledge to the test, experiment and explore the cosmos.
